title: FBI warns of FortiBleed: attackers accessed 86,000+ internet-exposed Fortinet devices
content_md:
CW: FortiGate/FortiVPN compromise. The FBI warns: in the FortiBleed operation, attackers gained access to more than 86,000 internet-exposed Fortinet devices.
